guide-text:
Navigation
Hold in either hand to show the top-center heading scale. Chinese cardinal text appears above the ticks, with an upright triangle touching the scale from below. The HUD has no background panel or icons. Outdoor wind disturbs the scale; rooms and quartz covers protect it. With VSCN Civilization Simulation installed, hold Ctrl and scroll while holding a compass to toggle tribe navigation. The text 部落 appears above the scale, offset upward if it overlaps a cardinal label; targets outside the visible span keep their label at the corresponding edge. Repeat to hide the tribe marker. Right-click a placed compass to nudge its pointer.

Needle
Hold a magnetite nugget in the right hand, sneak, and hold right-click into empty air for 10 seconds. Two-handed rubbing makes a soft friction sound. One nugget produces one needle. Releasing, switching items or targeting anything cancels.

Mariner compass
4 matching planks + 1 copper plate + 1 needle. Supports 12 vanilla species and two aged woods. Craft a cover from 2 clear quartz and combine it with the compass for wind protection.

Sinan
Carve a magnetite nugget with a chisel (20 durability) to make the rough spoon. Form and fire a blue/red/fire-clay mold; cast 200 units of copper. Carve low copper lettering and line relief on the thin sheet with a chisel (10 durability). Assemble the finished plate and spoon.
